# 7. Analysis: Males

## 7.1 Survival is correlated with environmental variables

```{r}
#| label: male-models-calc
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# Base model: additive environmental effects with natural spline for age
Survival_male_base <- brm(
  Survival ~ wtd114 + pop_den + avg_snow_depth + days_count + median_density + ns(Age, 3) + (1 | Yr),  
  data = Data_male_scaled,
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  cores = 4, chains = 4, warmup = 4000, iter = 10000, 
  threads = threading(2), backend = "cmdstanr", seed = 1247511982
)
```

## 7.2 Survival is correlated with environmental variables in interaction with age

```{r}
#| label: male-models-calc-age
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# Alternative model: environmental variables modulated by age
Survival_male_age <- brm(
  Survival ~ wtd114 + pop_den + ns(Age, 3) * (avg_snow_depth + days_count + median_density) + (1 | Yr),  
  data = Data_male_scaled,
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  cores = 4, chains = 4, warmup = 4000, iter = 10000, 
  threads = threading(2), backend = "cmdstanr", seed = 1424651365
)
```

## 7.3 Survival is correlated with environmental variables in interaction with population density

```{r}
#| label: male-models-calc-dens
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# Alternative model: environmental variables modulated by population density
Survival_male_pop <- brm(
  Survival ~ wtd114 + pop_den * (avg_snow_depth + days_count + median_density) + ns(Age, 3) + (1 | Yr),  
  data = Data_male_scaled,
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  cores = 4, chains = 4, warmup = 4000, iter = 10000, 
  threads = threading(2), backend = "cmdstanr", seed = 1273420879
)
```

## 7.4 Selection & Results

```{r}
#| label: male-results
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# Model comparison via LOO-CV
loo_male_base <- loo(Survival_male_base)
loo_male_pop  <- loo(Survival_male_pop)
loo_male_age  <- loo(Survival_male_age)

loo_compare(loo_male_base, loo_male_pop, loo_male_age)

# Posterior predictive check
pp_check(Survival_male_base, ndraws = 100, type = "bars")

# Prior sensitivity analysis & probability of direction
power_analysis_male <- powerscale_sensitivity(Survival_male_base)
p_direction(Survival_male_base)

# Model summary and export to Word table
ft_male <- flextable(extract_brms_summary(Survival_male_base, "Male")) |> autofit()
ft_male

doc <- read_docx()       
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft_male)   
print(doc, target = "result_model_male.docx")
```
